newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia CEO plans March road show to US, UK.
newsitem.headline: Nokia CEO plans March road show to US, UK.

text.p: Jorma Ollila, president and CEO of Finnish telecommunications group Nokia Oy, will take a road show to investors in New York and London in early March, Ulla James, Nokia's manager for investor relations, said on Tuesday.
"This is the CEO's regular yearly road show in connection with the reporting of annual results," she told Reuters by telephone, but declined to give exact dates for the trip.
"This is not a public event," James said.
During the year, Nokia plans to take a road show to all the most important cities where its stock is listed -- New York, London, Helsinki and Stockholm -- James said.
